description.text: The fourth and last expansion pack of the ★neo series, released in Japan in April 2001 and aimed at experienced players. Next to its Dark Pokémon it brought in Light Pokémon, whose powers tend to help both players and not only their owner, and it carries on with Shining Pokémon, eight of them, among them Shining Charizard and Shining Mewtwo. In English it became Neo Destiny in February 2002.
